_comment: HA copy for /playlists/. Mirrors scripts/lib/_playlist_copy.py (the EN source). Cards are keyed by Spotify playlist id, lanes by lane key. Playlist names are proper nouns and stay in the source module. Values are HTML-ready: no raw < or " characters.

ui.platformsLabel: Cikakken tarin yana kan Apple Music ma

intro: Jerin waƙoƙi talatin da tara da waƙoƙi 1,763, an gina su domin sa'o'in da ke buƙatar kiɗa a baya: aiki mai zurfi, dogon karatu da sake rubutu da dare.

Neo soul da nu jazz idan aiki na buƙatar haƙuri. Boom bap da jazz rap idan yana buƙatar ƙarfin tafiya. French touch, deep house da disco house idan yana buƙatar ɗagawa. Lo-fi domin sashen da ake sunkuyar da kai, sai kuma bugun Yammacin Afirka da ke ratsa dukan abin.
Kowane jerin waƙoƙi na kunnawa kyauta a Spotify, kuma cikakken tarin yana kan Apple Music.

faq.heading: Tambayoyi? Amsoshi.
faq.sub: Yadda za a saurara, a kan me, da kuma inda kiɗan ya fito.

items.q: Ina buƙatar biyan kuɗin Spotify domin sauraro?
items.a: A'a. Kowane jerin waƙoƙi na kunnawa a cikin na'urar da ke sama tare da asusun Spotify na kyauta, tare da tallace-tallace tsakanin waƙoƙi. Asusun Premium na cire tallace-tallace tare da ba da damar sauraro ba tare da yanar gizo ba, amma babu abin da ke nan a bayan biyan kuɗi.

items.q: Zan iya sauraro a Apple Music maimakon haka?
items.a: Eh — ku bi shafin a music.apple.com/profile/bxhero. Jerin waƙoƙin da ke wannan shafin sigogin Spotify ne, domin Apple Music ba ya bayyana hanyoyin haɗi na kowane jerin waƙoƙi ga jama'a. A wannan dandalin, bin shafin shi ne hanyar da za a dogara da ita.

items.q: A kan wane na'ura ne suke aiki?
items.a: Duk inda Spotify ke aiki: iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows, Apple Watch, Apple TV, CarPlay, Sonos, Google Nest, PlayStation, Xbox da kowane mai bincike. Na'urorin kunnawa da ke wannan shafin suna aiki a wayar hannu da kwamfuta ba tare da manhaja ba.

items.q: Wane jerin waƙoƙi zan fara da shi domin aiki mai zurfi?
items.a: Safiya & yanayi domin mai da hankali ba tare da hargitsi ba — downtempo, nu jazz da lo-fi da murya kaɗan ko babu ita, domin kada ta yi gasa da karatu. Lantarki ya dace da aikin da ke buƙatar ƙarfin tafiya maimakon nutsuwa.

items.q: Sau nawa ake sabunta jerin waƙoƙin?
items.a: A kai a kai, kuma a wurin. Bin jerin waƙoƙi a Spotify ko bin shafin a ɗaya daga cikin hidimomin biyu ya isa: sabbin waƙoƙi suna zuwa da kansu ba tare da an dawo nan ba.

items.q: Zan iya raba ko haɗa waɗannan jerin waƙoƙin?
items.a: Eh. Kowane kati na kai ga jerin waƙoƙi a Spotify, inda menu na rabawa ke ba da hanyoyin haɗi da lambar haɗawa. Jerin waƙoƙin jama'a ne, ana iya raba su cikin walwala.

items.q: Wa ke yin waɗannan jerin waƙoƙin?
items.a: Sebastien Rousseau — a matsayin BXHERO a Spotify da Apple Music. Waɗannan su ne jerin waƙoƙin da ake kunnawa yayin rubutu game da biyan kuɗi da injiniyanci, ba wani jerin da algorithm ya samar ba.

everywhere.heading: Saurara a kowace na'ura
everywhere.body: Kowane jerin waƙoƙi na kunnawa a mai bincike da ke sama, da kuma a manhajar Spotify a kan na'urorin da kuka riga kuka saba amfani da su. Ku bi shafin a ɗaya daga cikin hidimomin biyu, sai sabbin jerin waƙoƙi su zo da kansu.
